Variants.Content: The Sarsfield family is a noble family in the West. Their emblem is a green arrow with a white diagonal band on a red background. There are not many grand legends about them, so the real visible roots are more important: territory, marriage, obligations to Casterly Rock, and the ability to protect farmland from bandits and armies. The glory of a small family is usually not to conquer the world, but to guard the land for generations, fulfill promises and not let their name disappear.

The nobles of the West knew that Sarsfield was not the richest vassal, but he could provide archers and riders. As long as they answer the call on time and guard the manor, the green arrows will have their place.

Woodland hunters and farmers are concerned about whether hunting regulations leave a way for the poor to survive. If the lord punishes stealing a rabbit more seriously than stealing a field, the green hunter will only frighten the villagers.
